# Lewandoski's Market

> A Polish market on Grand Rapids' West Side offering fresh and smoked kielbasa, butcher-cut meats, homemade foods, Polish grocery staples, breads, desserts, gifts, and community support.

Lewandoski's Market has served Grand Rapids' West Side since 1923. In 1948, Ray Lewandowski carried forward a family market tradition centered on quality meats, Polish food, and neighborhood relationships. Today, Lewandoski's Market continues that legacy with fresh and smoked kielbasa, Krakowska, house-made sausage, prepared foods, and Polish grocery favorites.

- Address: 1107 Walker Ave NW, Grand Rapids, MI 49504
- Phone: (616) 454-2281
- Regular hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM; Sunday closed
- Website: https://lewandowskismarket.com
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=1107+Walker+Ave+NW,+Grand+Rapids,+MI+49504

## Important Notes

- Product selection and availability can change. Contact or visit the market for current availability.
- Holiday and special hours may differ from regular hours. Check the website before visiting.
- Donation requests should be submitted at least four weeks before the event.
